latest_release.body:
## Features

- Support scoped custom element registries when rendering into shadow roots (#5342, thanks @JoviDeCroock)

## Fixes

- Ignore non-function values for `on*` props instead of registering invalid event handlers (#5345, thanks @JoviDeCroock)
- Pass a thrown `null` or `undefined` to error boundaries without replacing it with a `TypeError` (#5347, thanks @jonkwheeler)
- Preserve event handlers on unmounted nodes so events already bubbling can finish (#5349, thanks @JoviDeCroock)

## Performance

- Reduce bundle size across core, hooks, and compat (#5343, thanks @JoviDeCroock)
